briefdescription.para: A "goto" statement is any statement that impacts the control flow of the program by jumping from the point of the "goto" statement.

detaileddescription.para: Thanks to Dijkstra, the term "goto" is now verboten, and its use is considered to be harmful; as a result, languages must use terms like "break" and "continue", and allow the use of such terms in a far more limited and predictable manner.
